description: This file is a header file defining the API and data structures for Device.IP.Diagnostics.DownloadDiagnostics in a TR-069 compliant device. It declares functions for setting diagnostic parameters related to download diagnostics, including diagnostics state, interface, URL, Ethernet priority, and DSCP. It also includes relevant include statements and licensing information.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the DiagnosticsState parameter to control the state of download diagnostics, such as initiating a test or retrieving status.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_Interface
methods.description: Sets the network interface used for the download diagnostics test, such as specifying the source IP address or interface.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DownloadURL
methods.description: Sets the URL from which the device will perform the download test, supporting HTTP or FTP URLs.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_EthernetPriority
methods.description: Sets the Ethernet priority code for marking packets during the diagnostic test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DSCP
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for marking packets during the download diagnostic test.
